posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
One of these day I'm going to have to inventory all the junk I've got. I've been planning on building a beam dump for the new laser and this morning I realized I already had one.

What I don't have though is a pinout for the connector.

Has anyone seen this shutter/beam dump before? If so, do you have a pinout?

The sticker says:

> Summit Technology, UV 321900 Rev: A, LOT: 120008/1"
 

I've googled these and come up largely empty unless [this shows](http://www.ftc.gov/os/1998/08/d09286suagr.htm) what happened to the company.

![Image](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/d/5879-4/Shutter1.jpg)

![Image](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/d/5883-4/Shutter2.jpg)

posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md: Look at all the electronics in there! Why not just run voltage to the rotary solenoid that moves the shutter? Try 5VDC, then 12VDC.

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
Mostly cause the whole thing looks useful. It looks like there's a feedback mechanism to indicate that the shutter is indeed open or closed and there's probably some power meter circuitry in there as well.

I'll be left all on my own for the next couple of days so I'll probably spend some time poking at it with a meter and power supply. I was hoping to take the easy road though.
